qtab[,-1] %>% rowSums() %>%
  cbind(qtab[,1], `total_ba`=.) %>%
  get_long_table(quant=., metadata=md) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y=value, x=paste(age_status, phase), fill=age_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.4) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge())+
  ylab("Stool Total BA (pmol/mg)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = age_young_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = age_young_colors) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=sample_name),color="black", size=3, max.overlaps = 20 )+
  stat_compare_means()
